nights.title: TYLA - THE A*POP WORLD TOUR
nights.name: Tyla
nights.extract: Tyla Laura Seethal known mononymously as Tyla, is a South African singer-songwriter. Dubbed the "Queen of Popiano", her musical style is characterised by a fusion of pop and amapiano.

nights.title: Josh Fawaz
nights.name: Josh Fawaz
nights.extract: Josh Fawaz is an Australian music producer and disc jockey.

nights.title: NGHTMRE: The NGHTMRE Before Xmas Tour ( 21+ )
nights.name: Nghtmre
nights.extract: Tyler Marenyi, better known by his stage name Nghtmre, is an American DJ and electronic dance music producer from Raleigh, North Carolina.
